newsitem.title: CHINA: First Shanghai in asset purchase talks.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai in asset purchase talks.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said it has made an offer to China Assets (Holdings) Ltd to buy the company's entire 33 percent interest in Goodbaby Child Products Co Ltd for not more than US$10 million.
The offer, which may or may not be accepted, would lift First Shanghai's stake in the child products maker to 66.01 percent from 33.01 percent, First Shanghai said in a statement on Wednesday.
The statement also said First Shanghai was in preliminary talks with Yaohan International Holdings Ltd to buy Yaohan's entire stake in Whimsy Entertainment Co Ltd.
Yaohan International has an interest of about 36 percent in Whimsy, an amusement centre operator.
"The said negotiations are at a preliminary stage and the acquisition and offer may or may not proceed," First Shanghai said.
Trading on First Shanghai shares resumed on Wednesday after being suspended on Tuesday pending an announcement. The shares were down HK$0.175 at HK$2.15 in early trade.
